newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bolger says Peters responsible for budget, RBNZ.
newsitem.headline: Bolger says Peters responsible for budget, RBNZ.

text.p: Prime Minister Jim Bolger on Friday released details of the division of responsibilities of Treasurer Winston Peters and Finance Minister Bill Birch confirming Peters will present the budget and be responsible for the Reserve Bank and the policy targets agreement.
In letters to Peters and Birch made public by Bolger, he said the Treasury would not be split and a single department would service both the Treasurer and the Finance Minister.

"As Treasurer you will be the senior minister. The budget shall be your responsibility and will be brought together with the minister of finance. You will present the budget to parliament," Bolger said in his letter to Peters.
He said Peters would also be responsible for the Reserve Bank Act and the policy targets agreement, which sets the bank's inflation target.
Peters would also have responsibility for the Overseas Investment Commission which apporves purchases of New Zealand assets by foreign companies and individuals.
